tasks.title: Remove dead code
tasks.prompt: Find and remove unused functions, imports, and feature-gated code that no target compiles. Keep the build green.

tasks.title: Clippy clean
tasks.prompt: Fix every clippy warning with -D warnings across the workspace. No #[allow] without a one-line justification.

tasks.title: Doc comment sweep
tasks.prompt: Add missing doc comments on public items; fix stale ones that contradict the code.

tasks.title: Final gate
tasks.prompt: Run the full test suite and the format check; fix anything the parallel cleanup broke.
